summary: Iteration 27: retested OFFLINE payment mode after main-agent fix on GET /api/orders projection (server.py:1567) and added vendor-owning happy path for /orders/collect/{code}. Also completed frontend coverage that iteration 26 skipped: Master Reconciliation card + Vendor Scan & Collect scanner (manual-entry flow, camera path is not reachable in headless). Result: 24/24 backend tests passing, all frontend testids present and wired to backend. No new bugs.

minor.issue: ready_for_collection / collected / cancelled buckets still hard-code amount=0 (server.py L1551-1553). Cosmetic — spec required counts, but inconsistent with the six payment buckets. Carried over from iter-26.
collection_code has no unique index and no collision retry on generation. Fine at current volume, worth adding a partial unique index for future safety. Carried over from iter-26.

backend_verification.regression_fixed: TestOrderListNewFields::test_order_list_projection_exposes_collection_code — was failing in iter-26, now passes after server.py:1567 projection now includes collection_code, payment_mode, payment_method, paid_at.

master_reconciliation_card.recon-bucket-{total,pending,paid,unpaid,: all 6 present with count + ₹ amount (e.g. Total 6 ₹600, Paid 6 ₹600)
master_reconciliation_card.note: Dashboard route is /master/dashboard (not /master). AppRoutes root redirect '/master' -> '/master/dashboard' would be nicer; currently /master shows 'No routes matched location /master' warning in console, but the auto-post-login redirect lands on /master/dashboard so real users never hit /master.

vendor_scanner_flow.scanner-manual-toggle -> scanner-manual-: all wired; typing CRV-TEST99 then continue advances to confirm phase
vendor_scanner_flow.scanner-confirm-btn: on click POSTs /api/orders/collect/{code}; on 404 shows scanner-error-panel with backend message 'No order found with code CRV-TEST99' — integration verified.
vendor_scanner_flow.note: Happy-path scanner-success-panel not exercised via UI because we did not create a real order matching the seeded vendor's vendor_id (would require menu/site scaffolding). Backend happy path is fully covered by pytest suite. Camera flow (html5-qrcode) not reachable in headless — manual-entry fallback is the documented automated path.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1567 fix is correct — projection now includes collection_code, payment_mode, payment_method, paid_at plus pickup_qr. Projection test now passes.

server.py L1479 vendor ownership check on /orders/collect works: seeded non-owning vendor correctly received 403; owning vendor 200; second call 409. Non-string comparison (str(ObjectId) vs stored str) worked because user.vendor_id is stored as str in the throw-away doc, matching order.vendor_id. Prod path: create_order stores vendor_id as str, so this is consistent.
Dashboard.js: '/master' has no matching route (console warns 'No routes matched location /master'); consider adding a root redirect to /master/dashboard so deep-links to /master don't blank-screen.
CollectionScanner.js integration surface is clean: all 3 phases (scan/confirm/success/error) have distinct data-testid roots and are wired to /api/orders/collect/{code}.

Reconciliation card in Dashboard.js correctly consumes both new response shape ({buckets, payment_mode}) and renders every requested testid. amount for status pills is intentionally omitted in UI, matching backend which returns amount=0.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (camera scan excluded, requires physical device)
